target: Smooth 60 fps remains open. User-requested literal V -prod experiment completed.
scope: Scroll-changing native layer publications after updateLayer, divided by the entire first-to-last actual native-input window; physical display scanout unmeasured.

protocol.profile_cache: Fresh private empty profile/cache; direct live HTTPS; automatic author scripts; OS filesystem/shader caches retained.
protocol.v_flags: -prod -prealloc -gc none, with ordinary project definitions and the 10G compiler limit; no -parallel-cc.
protocol.generated_c_flags: V defaults: -O2 -flto and -mllvm -inline-threshold=75; no custom C -O3 or 1500 inlining threshold.
protocol.pixel_bound: Existing maximum channel error three, unchanged.

decisions.default_settings: Both unprofiled runs complete600 inputs and exit normally: 66.4430862545 / 76.0891653268 scroll publications per second; p95 34.282958 / 31.765792 ms; deadline misses33.1140351% /20.5555556%. Maximum pixel error3 in a separate diagnostic. This does not reach smooth60.
decisions.combined_image_filter_flags: On literal-prod, matched pairs86.16 to85.54 and81.64 to84.18 are mixed; keep all3 options off. Eligibility:58 bounded filters,6 owned mascot upload hits and1 static MSAA image; max error3.
decisions.profile: Separate instrumented default-settings profile still shows synchronous GPU waits, retained row copies, filters and image preparation. Its83.26fps is diagnostic and does not replace either unprofiled result.
decisions.early_submission: Uncommitted prototype removed after expanded mixed-MSAA checks failed. Initial exact native backend tests and simpler shape/video comparisons passed; adding gradients exposed candidate CPU error4 beyond limit3. A native-grid follow-up differed from its control by9 (candidate CPU error1), so no live timing or acceptance credit was collected. Rejected patch and failures retained.
decisions.build_tools: All25 corrected build supervisor tests pass. The initial selection failed because duplicate --no-parallel-cc arguments were accepted, queuing an unintended non-prod request; duplicate flags are now rejected and the explicit literal-prod request is preserved. Actual build and headless smoke exit0 under their memory guards.

limitations: Earlier measured prealloc builds used C -O3 with parallel C, not V literal -prod. This experiment changes V generation, C optimization and linking; it cannot isolate a parallel-cc effect.

Shared source changes and host compilation continued. Same-cohort trials pin executable and native-library identities, but comparisons with earlier builds do not establish isolated compiler-mode gains.

All nine trials use the same pinned completed single-unit literal-prod executable (SHA256 2108b479b0b4af86534077ae60bb8e7851ec19c4c1c8f76c58432d07d827d452). Later shared production bundles are separate identities.
Every attempt, actual input cadence, full interval distribution, deadline miss count, leading/trailing publication gap, browser/guard exit and host load is retained.
Physical display presentation was not measured. Earlier archives are unchanged.
